settings_registry_agents_agent_args_desc: Help line under the "Extra arguments" row in Settings > Agents, also shown in search results.
settings_registry_agents_agent_args_labe: Label of the "Extra arguments" row in Settings > Agents, also its title in search results.
settings_registry_agents_agent_custom_de: Help line under the "Add agent" row in Settings > Agents, also shown in search results. The {…} placeholders are shortcuts filled in by the app.
settings_registry_agents_agent_default_d: Help line under the "Default agent" row in Settings > Agents, also shown in search results.
settings_registry_agents_agent_permissio: Help line under the "Tool approval" row in Settings > Agents, also shown in search results.
settings_registry_agents_description: One line under the Agents page title in Settings, and the tooltip of its sidebar entry.
settings_registry_agents_dock_enabled_de: Help line under the "Show the dock" row in Settings > Agents. The last sentence is only for Windows and Linux, where the dock starts hidden.
settings_registry_agents_label: Sidebar entry and page title of the Agents section in Settings.
settings_registry_agents_quick_descripti: Help line under the "Quick commands" row in Settings > Agents, also shown in search results.
